title: DEVICE AND METHODS FOR PRODUCING EDGE PROTECTION COATINGS, THE DEVICE HAVING A FLEXIBLE BASE PLATE, A CHANNEL, AND A SEALING LIP

features.item: cordless handheld vacuum lifting device with integrated battery power
flexible sealing lip on suction cup that bounds sealed region against workpiece
features.quote: A sealing lip is arranged on the side of the channel which faces away from the toothed side, the sealing lip preventing an undesired escape of the material or coating material.
features.note: This passage describes a sealing lip that prevents material escape, implying it bounds a region against a surface.
features.refuted: The quote describes a sealing lip preventing material escape, but does not specify it is on a suction cup, flexible, or bounds a sealed region against a workpiece.

features.item: electric vacuum pump mounted within rigid body to draw air from sealed region
pressure sensor monitoring vacuum level in sealed region
warning indicator activated when vacuum falls to threshold above release vacuum level
warning threshold defined relative to load-release vacuum rather than working vacuum
warning indicator remains active while grip vacuum persists below threshold
rechargeable battery integrated into rigid body powering vacuum pump
warning indicator positioned on rigid body for visibility during lifting operation
single-hand portable design with all components carried by rigid body without external hose or cord
features.quote: The device according to the present invention is designed in the manner of a doctor blade so that liquid or pasty materials, such as, for example, coating materials, can be applied uniformly and continuously to a curved substrate surface.
features.note: The reference describes a 'doctor blade' device for applying coatings, which is typically a handheld tool, but does not explicitly state it is a single-hand portable design or that all components are carried without external hoses or cords.

overall.why: The reference describes a device for applying coatings, which is a different application than a vacuum lifting device. While it mentions a flexible base plate and a sealing lip, these are in a different context and for a different purpose. Many core features of the subject invention are absent.
